additional_info.subject: RE: ID0370565-DC/Si-D/PL-[PWnLON] Charging Issue CRM:00798001058
additional_info.body:
Hi,
as announced, I attach a summary of today's station tests. The report from the client includes the hours of testing (Polish time).
At the end there are questions for us.
“We conducted the test sessions from
9:30 - 11:00
13:30 - 15:00
During the tests, we implemented scenarios with the start of charging using the corporate profile, private profile in combination with remote commissioning and RFID authentication.
We discontinued the test scenarios due to too frequent disconnections of the OCPP connection between the station to the CSMS server (Polenergia Engine).
The information gathered allows us to make further activities in diagnosing the problem.
Observations
1 It is possible to start and conduct charging transactions, regardless of the order in which the cable is connected to the vehicle.
It is also possible to conduct charging transactions on two charging points simultaneously.
2. The start of charging is hindered, by frequent disconnections of the OCPP connection, as a result of which:
a.         The request to start charging by the driver and operator cannot be sent - offline status
b.         Charging start requests (RemoteStartTransaction) are not forwarded to the station, as the OCPP connection is broken before being sent
c.         Charging start requests (RemoteStartTransaction) are not handled by the charging station
The station accepts the message, but reports an internal authorization error and does not start charging.
3. station reports charging point failure several times during testing
Activities
i4B team
- Assess the stability of OCPP connections by connecting an OCPP protocol tester
SIEMENS team
- Analysis and explanation of the cause of the internal authorization error during the commissioning attempt
- Analysis and explanation of the cause of the temporary error of the failed charge point
- Analysis and support in evaluating OCPP connection instability”
I will try to get an additional excel, where the times of the given activities performed at the station are indicated.
Thank you for your help!
With best regards,
Szymon Brodowicz
Siemens Sp. z o.o.

Is the issue of the OCPP protocol the process of starting a loading session? It is often the authorisation that is the problem. Consequently, when it fails the session does not start.
Sicharge D - even without authorisation and a connected backend - starts a loading session in often several to several tens of seconds. This is a long time compared to Alpitronic.
